Intelligent Model Routing on Replit

Replit now picks the best model for every task, automatically.

Published:

Aug 26, 2026

Updated:

Aug 27, 2026

The Replit Team

You want to bring an idea to life, not compare models.

But the best model for the task can change week to week, project to project, task to task. Choosing the right one adds another decision point between your idea and the thing you’re making.

Starting today, Intelligent Model Routing is available to everyone on Replit. As each task evolves, we match it with the model best suited to complete it - balancing quality, speed, and cost behind the scenes.

In our testing, Intelligent Model Routing delivered the same output quality at 65% lower cost than the previous version of Max Mode.

Free Mode lets you build more for less. Intelligent Model Routing gives you power when the task demands it and efficiency when it doesn’t. This is accessible intelligence that puts every user at the apex of speed, quality and cost.

Replit gets you outcomes. You stay in control.

Our deep expertise and access to a broad range of AI models enables us to test how they perform on real tasks. We use those results to understand which models are best suited to different kinds of work, then apply that understanding to every task.

Intelligent Model Routing is designed to make creation accessible, but this doesn’t mean the experience gets less flexible or transparent.

All users will start in Free Mode, and will be notified when their work escalates to higher-powered modes that can incur usage costs. Users can always over-ride this, and choose to remain in Free Mode.

Core & Pro users can also still manually select models if they want.

Intelligent Model Routing for Enterprises

Enterprise teams can use Intelligent Model Routing while maintaining control over which models are available to their users.

Administrators can define the approved model set for each workspace based on company policy. Replit then automatically chooses the model best suited to each task from that approved set.

Users can focus on how AI can augment their work, instead of model management. Administrators can give their teams access to AI while retaining control over the models they use.

This is accessible intelligence

Our goal is simple: making intelligence accessible to everyone. Intelligent Model Routing brings us another step closer, by handling more complexity behind the scenes.

Start creating with Intelligent Model Routing today on replit.com.
